title: Ad bidder latency metrics: histogram buckets that don't add up
name: Bidder latency histogram

questions.prompt: The bidder's latency SLO alert has paged on-call every night this week, but the exchanges report that almost all our bids arrive in under 20ms. On the Grafana dashboard, histogram_quantile() p99 latency jumps around unpredictably, and the +Inf bucket in /metrics is far smaller than bidder_latency_ms_count. Fix histogram.ts so the tests pass.
